def aggregate(self):
    aggregators: List[AggregatorInterface] = [
        CommentsAggregator(self.repo),
        LikesAggregator(self.repo),
        FollowersAggregator(self.repo),
    ]
    aggregators_by_type: Dict[EventType, AggregatorInterface] = {}
    for agg in aggregators:
        aggregators_by_type[agg.type] = agg

    for event in self.events:
        aggregator = aggregators_by_type.get(event.type)
        if aggregator is not None:
            aggregator.add(event)

    items = chain.from_iterable(
        agg.aggregate() for agg in aggregators_by_type.values()
    )

    return sorted(items, key=attrgetter("published"), reverse=True)
